title: Egyptian Spicy Pasta Bake
description: A twist on traditional pasta bake, adding some heat from spicy ingredients and a taste of Egypt.
instructions: Cook pasta al dente, set aside.
In a pan, cook sliced sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan, cook until softened.
Add cooked pasta, chili flakes, and a pinch of salt to the pan, stir to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish, top with sliced Morbier cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley, serve hot.
